new_libraries.name: Voltino_TriSense
new_libraries.author: VoltinoLabs (Tomas Michal)
new_libraries.sentence: Advanced Sensor Fusion library for Voltino TriSense modules (ICM42688P, AK09918C, BMP580).
new_libraries.paragraph: Provides high-performance driver and fusion algorithms for the TriSense board. Features include: Advanced FIFO draining for lag-free integration, Gimbal-lock immune Quaternion Math, 10MHz SPI Turbo mode, 6-point Accelerometer calibration (Sphere Fit), and Hard/Soft Iron Mag calibration. Dynamic hardware FPU optimization automatically scales precision (float/double) for platforms like Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (RP2350) and ESP32.
